-cp '/opt/ji-stage6/*:/opt/ji-host/lib/*' io.github.diodeme.ji.stage6.Stage6Testkit \
  performance-populate /data >> "$root/output/performance-result.ndjson"
performance_phase=performance-cold
cold_stdout="$root/output/performance-cold.stdout"
set +e
docker run --rm --name ji-stage6-performance --cpus 2 --memory 4g --memory-swap 4g \
  -v "$host_runtime:/opt/ji-host:ro" -v "$performance/bootstrap:/opt/ji-stage6:ro" -v "$performance/data:/data" \
  -w /opt/ji-host --entrypoint /opt/ji-host/runtime/bin/java eclipse-temurin:21-jre-jammy \
  -cp '/opt/ji-stage6/*:/opt/ji-host/lib/*' io.github.diodeme.ji.stage6.Stage6Testkit \
  performance-cold /data /opt/ji-host > "$cold_stdout"
cold_exit_code=$?
set -e
cat "$cold_stdout" >> "$root/output/performance-result.ndjson"
test "$cold_exit_code" = 0
cold_p95=$(sed -n 's/^STAGE6_COLD_READY_P95_MILLIS=//p' "$cold_stdout")
case "$cold_p95" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
performance_phase=performance-resident-start
docker run -d --name ji-stage6-performance --network ji-stage6-performance-network --cpus 2 --memory 4g --memory-swap 4g \
